title: Geo Carncross: How to program computers (kos)
summary: A 2014 talk by Geo Carncross (geocar) demonstrating kOS, a minimalist operating system and programming environment built around the k language, with early screenshots.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a rare live look at kOS in action, and one that is fascinating and mind-bending.

quote.text: For those who want to see it in action, there's actually a talk about kOS on YouTube
